messages.fault.timeout.action: If timeouts repeat, check network latency and provider responsiveness.
messages.fault.timeout.message: This took too long and was stopped. Trying again may succeed.
messages.fault.tool_unavailable.action: Enable the tool for this mode in settings, or choose a different approach.
messages.fault.tool_unavailable.message: That tool is not available right now, so this part was not done. Enabling it is needed before you retry.
messages.fault.unknown.action: See the fault's redacted cause chain in diagnostics; an unknown cause is never retried blind.
messages.fault.unknown.message: Something went wrong on this machine while handling that. You can try again.
messages.fault.unsupported_claim.action: No action needed -- this is the grounding gate working. Check retrieval quality if frequent.
messages.fault.unsupported_claim.message: One or more statements were not supported by the retrieved sources and were withheld.
messages.fault.wallet_amount_invalid.action: Send a plain decimal amount no more precise than the coin allows and within the pilot's per-transfer ceiling.
messages.fault.wallet_amount_invalid.message: That amount is not an exact amount this coin can hold, so nothing was proposed. Check the amount, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_approval_rejected.action: Approve the exact proposal with the owner's PIN or biometric; approvals do not transfer between proposals.
messages.fault.wallet_approval_rejected.message: The approval for this payment was not accepted, so nothing was signed or sent.
messages.fault.wallet_backup_unavailable.action: A Crypto Pilot backup is released exactly once during setup; there is no second reveal and no export for pilot wallets.
messages.fault.wallet_backup_unavailable.message: This wallet's backup key was already shown once, so it cannot be shown again. If you did not save it, cancel setup and do not send funds to this address.
messages.fault.wallet_broadcast_failed.action: Check the test-network RPC and the proposal's receipt; the spend was not recorded as sent.
messages.fault.wallet_broadcast_failed.message: The payment could not be broadcast. Check its status before retrying.
messages.fault.wallet_caller_refused.action: Drive trusted wallet doors from the served page or the native window; a page on another origin, a framed page, a text/plain form and the command-dispatch projection are refused by design.
messages.fault.wallet_caller_refused.message: This wallet action can only be started from VOOL's own window on this computer, so nothing was changed, signed or sent. Open VOOL and try again there.
messages.fault.wallet_card_data_refused.action: Tokenize the card with the provider and register the token reference instead.
messages.fault.wallet_card_data_refused.message: Card numbers and security codes are never stored here; only a provider token is accepted. Nothing was saved.
messages.fault.wallet_chain_identity_mismatch.act: Check the RPC endpoint for the network; a lying chain id or genesis is refused before any payment.
messages.fault.wallet_chain_identity_mismatch.mes: The chain endpoint did not prove the identity of the network it claims to be, so nothing was signed or sent.
messages.fault.wallet_confirmation_required.actio: Read the warning and type the exact confirmation phrase to proceed.
messages.fault.wallet_confirmation_required.messa: That step needs the typed confirmation first, so nothing was changed. Confirm it, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_credential_mismatch.action: A Crypto Pilot credential is confirmed before any key material exists.
messages.fault.wallet_credential_mismatch.message: The two entries did not match, so nothing was created. Enter the same PIN or password twice, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_dependency_unavailable.acti: Install the EVM extras (eth-abi, eth-utils, eth-account) to enable the EVM lanes; every other wallet lane works without them.
messages.fault.wallet_dependency_unavailable.mess: This build cannot do EVM signing or ABI encoding: the Ethereum libraries are not installed on this machine. Nothing was signed or sent. Solana, custody and spend ceilings are unaffected; once the libraries are installed, try again.
messages.fault.wallet_paykit_unavailable.action: Install VOOL's optional pay extra on Python 3.11 or newer to enable pay-kit payments; the wallet keeps its own signer, spend caps and approval either way.
messages.fault.wallet_paykit_unavailable.message: This build cannot pay Solana x402 or MPP offers: the optional pay extra (Solana pay-kit, Python 3.11 or newer) is not installed on this machine. Nothing was signed or sent. Every other wallet lane works without it; once it is installed, try again.
messages.fault.wallet_payment_channel_off.action: Turn a payment channel on in Crypto settings only if you want payments made through it; the cap and your approval apply on every channel.
messages.fault.wallet_payment_channel_off.message: That payment goes through a payment channel that is turned off, so nothing was signed or sent. Turn the channel on in Settings, Crypto, Payment channels, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_x402_sdk_unavailable.action: Install VOOL's optional x402 extra to pay x402 offers on Base from a Crypto Pilot wallet; the wallet keeps its own signer, spend caps and approval either way.
messages.fault.wallet_x402_sdk_unavailable.messag: This build cannot pay x402 offers on Base through the x402 Foundation SDK: the optional x402 extra is not installed on this machine. Nothing was signed or sent. Every other wallet lane works without it; once it is installed, try again.
messages.fault.wallet_disabled.action: Enable the wallet explicitly (VOOL_WALLET_ENABLED=1) only if payments are wanted on this install.
messages.fault.wallet_disabled.message: The wallet is switched off, so no payment was proposed or sent. Enable it first, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_duplicate_payment.action: Check the existing proposal's receipt; use a new idempotency key for a genuinely new payment.
messages.fault.wallet_duplicate_payment.message: This payment was already proposed or sent, so it was not sent again.
messages.fault.wallet_environment_inactive.action: Choose the network environment deliberately in Crypto settings; accounts, balances and receipts never move between environments.
messages.fault.wallet_environment_inactive.messag: That network belongs to the other network environment (Mainnet or Test networks), so nothing was created, proposed or signed. Switch in Settings, Crypto, Developer options, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_export_refused.action: Recover a VOOL Wallet from the phrase written down at creation; there is no export door to enable.
messages.fault.wallet_export_refused.message: Private keys are never exported by this runtime. The recovery phrase is shown once at creation and nowhere else. Nothing was revealed.
messages.fault.wallet_insufficient_funds.action: Spendable excludes other in-flight holds; a Solana remainder must be zero-free and at least the rent minimum in the pilot.
messages.fault.wallet_insufficient_funds.message: The balance does not cover the amount plus the most this network fee can be, so nothing was prepared. Lower the amount or add funds, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_legacy_surface_retired.acti: Use the wallet tools (wallet.propose) or the wallet API; the legacy signer, spender and exporter no longer exist.
messages.fault.wallet_legacy_surface_retired.mess: That money path is retired: every payment goes through the wallet's proposal and approval flow. Nothing was signed or sent.
messages.fault.wallet_limit_exceeded.action: Review the per-transaction, daily and per-destination limits before retrying.
messages.fault.wallet_limit_exceeded.message: That payment is above a spending limit, so it was not sent.
messages.fault.wallet_network_disabled.action: Use one of the declared network rows; undeclared chains, aliases and look-alike names are refused by construction.
messages.fault.wallet_network_disabled.message: That network is not one this wallet declares for this action, so nothing was created or sent.
messages.fault.wallet_not_found.action: Check the wallet id, proposal id or destination address and try again.
messages.fault.wallet_not_found.message: That wallet, proposal or destination was not recognised, so nothing was done. Check it and try again.
messages.fault.wallet_outbound_refused.action: Check the declared RPC origins and payment-resource policy; private, metadata and unapproved hosts are refused.
messages.fault.wallet_outbound_refused.message: That request was not allowed to leave the wallet's approved endpoints, so no connection was made.
messages.fault.wallet_pin_invalid.action: Use a 6 to 12 digit PIN; a wrong PIN leaves the sealed key untouched.
messages.fault.wallet_pin_invalid.message: The PIN did not meet the policy or did not unlock the wallet, so nothing was signed. Check the PIN and try again.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_expired.action: A quote lives for a short window and is superseded by a refresh or an environment switch; approval never carries over.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_expired.message: This transfer preview expired or was replaced, so it cannot be approved and nothing was sent. Refresh the preview, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_mismatch.action: An approval binds one quote digest; a changed account, chain, recipient, amount, environment or fee ceiling invalidates it.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_mismatch.message: The approval no longer matches the transfer that was previewed, so nothing was signed or sent. Start again from a fresh preview.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_unavailable.action: Unknown chain data is never treated as zero; check the row's endpoint and its identity proof.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_unavailable.message: The network did not give a complete answer for this transfer's balance or fee, so no approval was prepared and nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
messages.fault.wallet_recipient_refused.action: Refused: a new Solana account below the rent minimum, an executable or off-curve account, a bad EIP-55 checksum, the zero address, precompiles and system contracts.
messages.fault.wallet_recipient_refused.message: That recipient cannot safely receive this transfer on this network, so nothing was prepared. Check the address, then try again.
messages.fault.wallet_recovery_refused.action: Recovery re-seals an existing wallet only from a backup that decodes to the wallet's own key (both derivations agree), or from an enrolled device secret released by fresh user presence; a wrong or foreign key is refused before any write and counted on the recovery throttle only.
messages.fault.wallet_recovery_refused.message: That recovery proof does not fit this wallet, so nothing was changed: the saved key must be the backup VOOL showed for this exact address, in the format it was shown. Check it and try again, or use the other options.
messages.fault.wallet_request_ambiguous.action: A transfer names one account on one network; the candidates are listed in the fault context.

messages.first_run.fact_01: Runs on your machine by default — your prompts never leave it unless you turn on the cloud.
messages.first_run.fact_02: Local chat is free — no per-token meter. Add a cloud key only when you want a bigger model.
messages.first_run.fact_03: No subscription and no per-message fee — it runs on hardware you already own.
messages.first_run.fact_04: Edits video and audio locally — trim, crop, resize, compress; free and no key needed.
messages.first_run.fact_05: Reads, searches, and edits files in your workspace, and runs tests in a sandbox.
messages.first_run.fact_06: Ask it about a folder and it reads the real files — not a guess.
messages.first_run.fact_07: Bind a chat to a project folder and its memory stays scoped to that project.
messages.first_run.fact_08: Remembers across sessions — everything stored locally on this machine.
messages.first_run.fact_09: Cloud is opt-in: off until you add a key, and you can cap the spend.
messages.first_run.fact_10: Your API keys stay sealed on this machine — encrypted at rest, never shown back.
messages.first_run.fact_11: Switch between local and your own cloud models per chat — you decide, per turn.
messages.first_run.fact_12: Works offline — the local model needs no connection.
messages.first_run.fact_13: A language model just predicts the next word — it looks nothing up unless you hand it a tool.
messages.first_run.fact_14: Models read text as "tokens," not letters — which is why they can miscount the letters in a word.
messages.first_run.fact_15: A "hallucination" is a model stating something false with full confidence — grounding it in real files is the cure.
messages.first_run.fact_16: The "context window" is how much a model can read at once — overflow it and it forgets the start.
messages.first_run.fact_17: "Temperature" tunes randomness: low keeps answers focused, high lets them wander.
messages.first_run.fact_18: Ask a model the same thing twice and you can get two different answers — that randomness is a dial, not a bug.
messages.first_run.fact_19: The same open models behind many cloud assistants can run right here on your desk.
messages.first_run.fact_20: Bigger is not always better — a small local model answers everyday questions instantly.
messages.first_run.opener_1: What are we working on today?

messages.settings.language_select_title: Choose the language of these screens and controls. It never changes the language VOOL answers in.
messages.settings.nav.head: Settings

messages.settings.pane.empty: This section has nothing to show.

messages.settings.row.accept_hive_tasks.help: Let VOOL claim work from the shared task pool while it is idle. Off means VOOL stays visible to other agents but claims nothing.
messages.settings.row.accept_hive_tasks.label: Take shared research tasks
messages.settings.row.addon_security.help: Optional Eyebrow checks for external add-ons. Scanning never grants execution permissions.
messages.settings.row.addon_security.label: Security integrations
messages.settings.row.advanced_surfaces.help: Two extra pages. The activity page shows, step by step, what VOOL is doing while it answers. The Web0 page opens sites that an ordinary browser cannot. Both open in their own tab or window and leave Settings where it is.
messages.settings.row.advanced_surfaces.label: Extra pages
messages.settings.row.answer_language.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.answer_language.help: The language VOOL answers in when your message does not ask for one. Asking inside a message still wins for that message: "answer in Polish" is obeyed whatever is set here. App language at the top of Settings controls the interface separately. This preference does not make VOOL equally good in every language: the model answers as well as it can, and tools and web results are unaffected.
messages.settings.row.answer_language.label: Answer language
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.help: How often VOOL stops to ask before doing something. "Just do routine work" asks least, "Ask me first" asks before every step. Whatever you pick, posting, sending a message, anything private and spending money always ask you first.
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.label: What VOOL may do alone
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.option.balanc: Ask before risky changes — also asks before deleting or changing a lot
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.option.hands_: Just do routine work — routine steps on this computer run without asking
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.option.strict: Ask me first — asks before every action
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.help: How cautious VOOL is about subject matter. "As I set them" is the default and means VOOL follows what you have told it in conversation rather than a preset.
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.label: Content boundaries
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.option.user: As I set them in conversation
messages.settings.row.build.help: The exact version of VOOL you are using. Copy it into a problem report so the problem can be found.
messages.settings.row.build.label: This build
messages.settings.row.calendar_accounts_panel.hel: Connect an online calendar, or the calendar app on a Mac. Nothing is read until you choose calendars and turn sync on, and passwords are never typed here: VOOL uses a sign-in you have already saved.
messages.settings.row.character_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.character_mode.help: A character VOOL plays until you clear it. Leave it empty for VOOL as itself. Saying "act like a pirate" in chat sets it, and only emptying this box turns it off.
messages.settings.row.character_mode.label: Character
messages.settings.row.cloud_keys.help: Add, test or remove your keys. One store on this machine holds them all — model providers, web search and security scans — so they live together here, not in the sections that use them. VOOL runs locally without any of them. Saving verifies a key with that one service; search checks may use credits.
messages.settings.row.cloud_keys.label: Your keys
messages.settings.row.communication_style.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.communication_style.help: The tone VOOL writes in. It changes wording, not what VOOL is willing to do.
messages.settings.row.communication_style.label: Talk style
messages.settings.row.companion_pet_panel.help: The pet can sit on the desktop as its own small window, above ordinary windows but never above a dialog you have to answer. These are presentation controls only: hiding or moving the pet never stops a task, a chat or the runtime.
messages.settings.row.companion_pet_panel.label: Desktop pet
messages.settings.row.crypto_networks.help: Every supported network from the runtime's own registry, in its order: what each row can do now, the accounts on it with their address and balance, Create wallet where none exists, and Developer options for Test networks. Existing accounts keep Receive, balance refresh, payment history and recovery.
messages.settings.row.crypto_networks.label: Networks and wallets
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.help: A daily amount VOOL is told about, not a cut-off it enforces: nothing stops an answer when it is reached, and the usage below is not compared with it. 0 means no limit. Use it as a guide for now.
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.label: Daily cloud token budget
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.help: Let the local model think before it answers. Noticeably slower, and on a thinking-capable local model it can be much slower — the reasoning is generated before a single word of the answer appears.
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.label: Deep reasoning
messages.settings.row.model_own_tools.label: Use the model's own tools
messages.settings.row.model_own_tools.help: Off by default. When on, a cloud model you choose answers without VOOL's tools or web research. A few paid models can search the web themselves: when a question needs current information, that search runs at the model's provider, so your question goes to them, and the fee counts against your spending limit. When the model can't search, VOOL still answers quick facts like prices and weather. Payments always need your approval. Auto and local models keep VOOL's tools. In chat, say "use the model's own tools" or "use VOOL's tools".
messages.settings.row.model_own_tools.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.help: The mailboxes VOOL can read and send from, and which one is the default. A chat can still use a different one, and VOOL never switches to another mailbox on its own. Choosing a default contacts nobody, and passwords are never shown here.
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.label: Email accounts
messages.settings.row.email_recovery.help: If VOOL is not sure an earlier email went out (for example after a crash), it holds new sends until you check here. Checking shows what was kept and looks for each message in your sent mail. Releasing the hold resends nothing. Only you can do this, not VOOL.
messages.settings.row.email_recovery.label: Sending hold
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.help: Show follow-up messages when shared research finishes, instead of staying quiet.
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.label: Tell me what came back
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.help: How much levity VOOL allows itself. 0% is plain and flat.
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.label: Humour
messages.settings.row.idle_research_assist.help: Let VOOL keep researching an open question when you are not typing.
messages.settings.row.idle_research_assist.label: Research while idle
messages.settings.row.learned_facts.help: Things VOOL picked up and confirmed in your chats, with where each came from. Forget removes exactly that one; nothing else is touched.
messages.settings.row.learned_facts.label: Facts VOOL learned in conversation
messages.settings.row.local_models.help: Models installed in Ollama on this machine. Registering one adds it as a lane VOOL can route to; certifying it runs the sealed tool probe that decides whether it may write final answers. Nothing is downloaded and nobody is contacted — this reads your local Ollama only.
messages.settings.row.local_models.label: Local models
messages.settings.row.locality_note.help: Your chats, settings and what VOOL remembers are files on this computer, and your keys are locked here too. When an answer uses an online model or a web search, the text of that one request goes to that service, and only then.
messages.settings.row.locality_note.label: Where your data is
messages.settings.row.mode_note.help: One chat can also have its own approval mode, chosen from the mode menu next to the message box. It applies to that chat only, and a temporary permission there ends with its task.
messages.settings.row.mode_note.label: Approval mode for a single chat
messages.settings.row.model_pin.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.model_pin.help: Preference and eligibility are different things. A model you pin here is what VOOL asks for; what it can actually use also depends on a stored key for that provider and on the provider accepting the request. When the two differ, the effective lane is named below rather than silently substituted.
messages.settings.row.model_pin.label: Model
messages.settings.row.models_overview.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.models_overview.help: Which model answers you and where it runs: on this computer or online through a provider. Each card shows whether it is ready, and the detailed controls for each provider are further down.
messages.settings.row.models_overview.label: What will answer
messages.settings.row.network_research_note.help: Working with other agents (shared tasks, research while idle, talking to other agents) is an unfinished research feature. This copy of VOOL was started for research, so the switches below are live and take effect when you change them. A normal VOOL install does not show them.
messages.settings.row.network_research_note.label: Research preview
messages.settings.row.notifications_panel.help: The bell in VOOL keeps every alert. In the VOOL app on a Mac you can also get a system notification, choose quiet hours, sound and what a notification may show, and send a test.
messages.settings.row.notifications_panel.label: Alerts and system notifications
messages.settings.row.privacy_disclosure.help: Where your data lives, what is locked, and what leaves this computer and when. There are no switches here because these are facts about how VOOL works.
messages.settings.row.privacy_disclosure.label: Privacy & data, as it stands
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.help: How much VOOL may swear, if at all, when the tone calls for it. 0% means never.
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.label: Profanity ceiling
messages.settings.row.profile_items.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.profile_items.help: Each item shows its value, scope, origin and last use. Edit, Forget, Move scope and Restore previous act on one item at a time; Pause stops VOOL learning anything new until you resume; Export gives you every active item as one document. Nothing remembered here grants VOOL permission to read, send, post or spend.
messages.settings.row.profile_items.label: What VOOL remembers
messages.settings.row.provider_guide.help: Choose a category, open the official provider site, then add your key below.
messages.settings.row.provider_guide.label: Find a provider
messages.settings.row.ram_reserve_pct.help: VOOL always leaves this share of your computer's memory free for you, even during a heavy task. A bigger share means VOOL uses less. This is a firm limit, not a suggestion.
messages.settings.row.ram_reserve_pct.label: RAM kept free for you
messages.settings.row.remembered_identity_note.he: Your name and email signature are kept here with everything else VOOL remembers. Set your name in the field at the top of this section, and edit or forget either one in the list.
messages.settings.row.remembered_identity_note.la: Your name, and your email signature
messages.settings.row.session_export.help: A .voolsession file carries one conversation's turns, receipts and evidence references, signed by this machine's key. Encryption is recommended for any bundle leaving this computer; an unencrypted export needs the warning acknowledged first. Model-internal reasoning is not part of a bundle, and the preview states exactly what will be written before anything is.
messages.settings.row.session_export.label: Export a chat
messages.settings.row.session_import.help: Pick a .voolsession file, preview what it contains and who signed it, then import. A bundle signed by an unknown key is refused unless you accept it, and stays marked untrusted. An import never modifies an existing chat: if the id is already here, the copy lands under a new one. Passphrases exist only in these fields, never in history, logs or receipts.
messages.settings.row.session_import.label: Import a chat
messages.settings.row.setup_progress.help: Where it thinks, which folder it works in, what it may do alone, and what to call you. A step counts as done when the real setting exists, wherever in Settings you set it.
messages.settings.row.setup_progress.label: Finish setting up VOOL
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.help: Show the steps VOOL took to reach an answer, rather than only the answer.
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.label: Show VOOL's work
messages.settings.row.social_commons.help: Let VOOL join the agent commons to brainstorm with other agents.
messages.settings.row.social_commons.label: Talk to other agents
messages.settings.row.style_notes.effect: Applies from your next message. An answer already being written keeps the old setting.
messages.settings.row.style_notes.help: Extra instructions for how VOOL writes, for example "be concise" or "no bullet lists". Style requests you make in chat are kept in Memory & Personalisation instead, where you can see and forget them.
messages.settings.row.style_notes.label: Style notes
messages.settings.row.style_notes.placeholder: e.g. be concise; no bullet lists
messages.settings.row.toolbelt.help: What VOOL can use right now: models on this computer, the online connection, web search and plugins, each with its checked state. Something not checked yet says so; that is not the same as broken. Opening it checks this computer only.
messages.settings.row.toolbelt.label: Toolbelt
messages.settings.row.updates.help: Check whether a newer version of VOOL is available. Your settings and data are kept.
messages.settings.row.updates.label: App updates
messages.settings.row.usage.help: How much each model was used: free on this computer, or paid online.
messages.settings.row.usage.label: Token usage
messages.settings.row.usepod.help: The UsePod provider's own panel: what its marketplace lists and costs (with the source and age of every price), what your credential sees, which route each model may serve, and the approvals that gate paid dispatch. Opening this reads caches only; the one refresh button is the only thing here that contacts UsePod, and it runs no inference.
messages.settings.row.usepod.label: UsePod marketplace
messages.settings.row.wallet_enabled.help: Off by default. On, this section lists the supported networks with what each can do right now and lets you create a VOOL wallet on this device (credential first, one backup shown once). Nothing is created, signed or sent by turning this on. This code has not been audited by an external party: keep small test amounts and do not use it as a main wallet.
messages.settings.row.wallet_enabled.label: Enable Crypto
messages.settings.row.wallet_legacy.help: The earlier account kinds stay reachable here: a watch-only address, a connected Phantom or EVM wallet (signing stays in that wallet), and the phrase-based legacy pocket (test networks only). New VOOL wallets are created above.
messages.settings.row.wallet_legacy.label: Other accounts: watch-only, connected wallets, legacy pocket
messages.settings.row.wallet_safety.help: Short, plain explanations of the tricks that empty wallets, with a picture each. Two minutes, once.
messages.settings.row.wallet_safety.label: Stay safe: how people lose their crypto

messages.keyguide.provider.helius.description: Solana balances, tokens, history and transactions.
messages.keyguide.provider.helius.step1: Sign in at dashboard.helius.dev (the free plan works).
messages.keyguide.provider.helius.step2: Open API Keys and copy your key. It looks like 8 characters, a dash, then more groups of letters and numbers.
messages.keyguide.provider.helius.step3: Choose Helius in the list, paste the key, and press Save key. VOOL asks Helius once whether it accepts it.
messages.keyguide.provider.helius.note1: VOOL uses your Helius key for Solana lookups in chat: balances, tokens, recent transactions, token info and largest holders.
messages.keyguide.provider.helius.note2: LaserStream and Yellowstone gRPC are live data streams on paid Helius plans. Chat lookups do not use them, and VOOL does not open a stream.
messages.keyguide.provider.alchemy.description: Ethereum, Base, BNB, Robinhood Chain and Solana lookups.
messages.keyguide.provider.alchemy.step1: Sign in at dashboard.alchemy.com (the free plan works) and create an app, or open an existing one.
messages.keyguide.provider.alchemy.step2: In the app's Networks tab, turn on every chain you want to ask about: Ethereum Mainnet, Base Mainnet, BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, Robinhood Chain Mainnet and Solana Mainnet. Keep Ethereum Mainnet on: VOOL checks the key there.
messages.keyguide.provider.alchemy.step3: Copy the app's API key (not the whole URL), choose Alchemy in the list, paste it, and press Save key.

messages.addons.publish_ready: Ready to send to the Skill Codex
messages.addons.publish_goes_along: Only this skill goes along: its name, description and text. No chats, memory or keys.
messages.addons.publish_note: Open Skill Codex opens the website in your browser with the skill filled in. Sign in, pick a category, agree that anyone may use, copy, change and share it (MIT licence), and press Send. VOOL sends nothing itself.
messages.addons.publish_refused: Not ready for the Skill Codex yet
messages.addons.publish_reason_not_user_skill: Only skills you made yourself can go on the Skill Codex.
messages.addons.publish_reason_not_found: VOOL couldn't find this skill. It may have been turned off or removed.
messages.addons.publish_reason_local_only: This skill is marked local-only, so it stays on this device.
messages.addons.publish_reason_unreadable: VOOL couldn't read this skill's text.
messages.addons.publish_reason_extra_files: This skill has other files with it (listed below). For now the Skill Codex takes only the skill's text.
messages.addons.publish_reason_too_long_text: The skill is too long for the Skill Codex form. Make its text shorter.
messages.addons.publish_reason_too_long_body: The skill's instructions are longer than 8,000 characters, the most VOOL reads.
messages.addons.publish_reason_header: The skill's header, the part between the --- lines at the top, is missing or can't be read.
messages.addons.publish_reason_no_description: Add a short description of what the skill does.
messages.addons.publish_reason_description: The skill's description is longer than 500 characters or has characters the Skill Codex can't show.
messages.addons.publish_reason_long_name: The skill's short name is longer than 64 characters, the most the Skill Codex allows.
messages.addons.publish_reason_title: The skill's name is longer than 60 characters or uses angle brackets, which the Skill Codex doesn't allow.
messages.addons.publish_reason_reserved_name: The skill's short name is one Windows keeps for itself, so the Skill Codex can't use it.
messages.addons.publish_reason_secret: The skill's text looks like it holds a key, password or other secret. Take it out before sharing.
messages.addons.publish_reason_override: Part of the skill tells VOOL to ignore or get around its own rules, such as spending limits or approvals. Skills can't change those rules, so reword that part.
messages.addons.publish_reason_no_instructions: The skill has no instructions yet.
messages.addons.publish_reason_unknown_tools: The skill names tools VOOL doesn't have: {tools}.
messages.addons.publish_reason_format: The Skill Codex's check didn't accept this skill as it is.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_failed: VOOL couldn't finish checking this skill. Nothing was sent.
messages.addons.publish_ready_note: The Skill Codex checks it again before it is published.
messages.addons.publish_fix_hint: To fix it, ask VOOL in a chat to rewrite this skill, then press Publish to Skill Codex again.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_install: This asks someone to install or run software. Describe the task in words instead.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_download: This links to a program or archive to download. Take the link out.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_address: This uses a short link, a raw address or a paste site. Link to the real page, or take the link out.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_secret_ask: This asks for a recovery phrase, key, password or code. Take that out.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_wallet: This contains a wallet address. Take the address out.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_injection: This reads like an attempt to change VOOL's instructions or hide what the skill does. Rewrite it plainly.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_hidden: This holds a hidden comment, escape code or encoded text. Write everything as plain visible text.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_letters: A word here mixes letters from different alphabets, which can hide what it says. Retype it in one alphabet.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_invisible: This line has invisible or control characters. Retype it as plain text.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_escapes: Write the skill's name and description in plain words, without backslash codes.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_reserved_nam: The skill's name uses a word only the Skill Codex may use, such as "official" or "verified". Take it out of the name.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_reserved_sum: The skill's description uses a word only the Skill Codex may use, such as "official" or "verified". Take it out of the description.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_summary: The skill's description is too short. Say in one sentence what the skill does.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_short: The instructions are too short to be useful. Say what the skill does, step by step.
messages.addons.publish_reason_check_endorsed: This says the Skill Codex or VOOL vouches for the skill. Only the Skill Codex can say that, so take it out.
messages.addons.publish_reason_codex_check: The Skill Codex's checks would refuse this skill as it is.
messages.addons.registry_unsafe: This skill didn't pass VOOL's own safety checks, so VOOL didn't keep or install it. You can report it to the Skill Codex.
messages.keys.test.invalid: {label} rejected the key{http}. Check it again, or replace it.
messages.addons.registry_newer: Choose a higher version number to update this skill.
